notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating two 1/1 Elemental tokens.
Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
